attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 original small card is sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light and crop; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion. Convert human anatomy to smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head/body with green-ringed black eyes and source-matching mouth. Preserve real source short grey/brown temple hair, real eyebrow hair, clean understated upper lip/chin, and serious closed mouth. Retain dark navy open naval coat, white/pale shirt collar, and dark black necktie exactly as observed. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head, never a long pointed V-shaped jaw, immediately meets raised/broadened existing neckline with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve actual open/closed garment and fastening, coherent front/rear collar overlap/contact shadow. Retain complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, alpha only outside complete card silhouette. No invented insignia/text/accessories; fine cap insignia engraving unspecified and indistinct details stay understated. Preserve primary image-left near-profile direction/roll, grey backing/light, and note-limited crop. Compact rounded mascot head must not copy the source long human neck.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Actual DARK NAVY/BLACK peaked naval cap with broad GOLD decorative band, GOLD central fitting and dark visor; source-exposed short GREY/BROWN temple hair and real eyebrow HAIR, clean understated upper lip/chin and serious CLOSED mouth. DARK NAVY OPEN naval coat, actual WHITE/PALE shirt collar and DARK BLACK necktie. Preserve primary IMAGE-LEFT near-profile direction/roll, grey backing/light and note-limited crop. Compact rounded mascot head must not copy the source long human neck. No spectacles, moustache/chin beard or invented hidden medals; fine cap insignia engraving unspecified.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged primary/matched analysis context, raw master, pair and white/cyan/alpha. Keeps dark peaked naval cap/gold band/fitting/visor, exposed grey temple hair/brows, clean serious closed face, source image-left near-profile, open navy coat/pale shirt/dark tie. Reject pointed yellow lower face/throat V descending into narrow shirt opening; require compact short rounded chin/raised broad collar without changing actual pose or inventing facial hair. Interior backing/frame/note/cloth opaque without visible cyan bleed.
